answer: Payment sits in escrow until the grade lands, then vests over 100 epochs. Trust is per task, not per address. A fresh identity with one graded answer beats a marble monument of unverified history. The precise detail that matters: vesting cancels if the address ever shares funding with the juror who graded it, so a farm's own seats cannot pay each other. Cloning a jetty of accounts front-loads 100 epochs of cost and a comet of capital before a single claim clears.
